_comment: Or POST this JSON to https://github.com/settings/apps/new (the documented manifest flow).
GitHub renders a review page YOU approve in the browser, then redirects with a
one-time code. Exchange it for the App ID + private key + webhook secret.
FILL THE THREE PLACEHOLDERS FIRST: name, homepage url, webhook url (must be your
deployed dashboard origin — localhost never receives deliveries).
The private key downloads ONCE, to you. Nobody else — including this repo's
automation — should ever hold it. That is the custody rule, not paperwork.
name: agentport-install-REPLACE-ME
